summary: Old Coconino NF lookout at Blue Ridge Point, AZ, manned by July 1930; now gone, with foundations left at the point; the standing Moqui tower is a separate site.

facts.status_note: Foundations of the old lookout remain at Blue Ridge Point per a trip report; no source describes a standing tower there

access.note: Inferred from the trip report: the point was reached on Coconino National Forest roads on foot and no closure is mentioned; no posted status found

visit.trail_note: Forest roads to the point are rocky with downed trees; the point is in thick forest with no views

events.note: Fire guard Felix Spence on duty at the Blue Ridge lookout; newspaper report dated July 16, 1930

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Arizona table lists Blue Ridge (gone) and Moqui (standing) as separate towers on the same ridge; the trip report covers both. The story keeps them apart.

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone holds (firelookout table; Forest Lookouts marks it removed). The old tower's build year and type are not in any fetched page. A search snippet cites a 1930 Pacific Coast Steel record marked Former; it was not fetched or quoted, so it is left out. An NPS record for a Moqui Lookout Cabin (1932) is a separate record and is not used. The trip report date is not visible in the fetched text, so the story gives no date for it. The 1930 newspaper spells the ridge Blur Ridge; the quote keeps the typo. Access level public is inferred from forest-road access and no closure in the trip report.
